index_event: First date on which both a diagnosis of heart failure and a diagnosis of end-stage renal disease are recorded on the same day (first co-occurrence).
inclusion_criteria: History of heart failure any time before the index date (prior diagnosis of heart failure at any time before the index event).
Diagnosis of end-stage renal disease on the index date as part of the co-occurrence.
Adults aged 18 years or older at the index date (age >= 18).
observation_window: Follow-up from index until end of continuous observation (end of enrollment) or death; no fixed follow-up duration.
prior_observation: No prior observation or continuous enrollment requirement before index.
cohort_exit: Exit cohort at end of continuous observation (end of enrollment) or at death.
